brief:
Palestinian farmers in Burin have resumed replanting and rebuilding greenhouses destroyed by Israeli settlers, according to Al Jazeera English. The destruction has targeted crops and agricultural structures across the community, yet residents have persisted in replanting despite the repeated damage to their fields and equipment.

The farmers have made reconstruction a centerpiece of their response to settler violence in the occupied West Bank. By continuing to plant and rebuild their greenhouses, Burin's agricultural community maintains its presence on the land and sustains its economic base. The commitment reflects the farmers' determination to preserve their livelihoods amid ongoing destruction of their property and crops.
dek: Israeli settler pogroms destroy greenhouses and crops, but Burin's farmers insist on rebuilding.
title: Palestinian farmers rebuild after Israeli settlers destroy West Bank crops
